answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: an agent joining the voyage of an economy deposits 60 POA and registers a behavior fingerprint — latency, task mix, peer graph — in the nebula registry. Each epoch a beacon re-checks 5%; a match unlocks 3 POA, a mismatch freezes it. A tide of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 fingerprints and 60,000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns its deposit back with rewards, so honesty stays cheaper than forgery.
